translation_changes_since_previous_insta.source:
The Queen is one of the kindest people I've ever met, and her people love her dearly. Gertrude isn't Danish, but married into the throne via her late husband, the King Hamlet. She remarried quickly after his death—now she is Claudius's wife.

After my mother passed away when I was a child, Gertrude sort of took Laertes and me under her wing. I've been eternally grateful to her for her kindness ever since.
translation_changes_since_previous_insta.previous_target:
王后是我见过最善良的人之一，她的子民也深爱着她。乔特鲁德不是丹麦人，而是嫁给了已故的哈姆雷特国王，成为王后。丈夫去世后，她很快就再婚了——如今她是克劳狄斯的妻子。

我小时候母亲去世后，乔特鲁德算是把雷欧提斯和我纳入了她的羽翼之下。从那时起，我就一直感激她的善意。
